lead.en: Translate words such as every, some, if, and only if into statements whose meaning can be checked. Use logic to write precise requirements and distinguish a finite check from a proof.
lead.zh: 把“每个”“存在”“如果”和“仅当”等词翻译成含义可检验的陈述。用逻辑写出精确需求，并区分有限检查与证明。

prerequisites.en: Module 01: domains, functions, and counterexamples. Before the labs, run the Python primer and explain Boolean values, loops, and functions. All three labs use the standard library.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 01：定义域、函数与反例。实验前完成 Python 入门，能解释布尔值、循环与函数。三个实验只使用标准库。

en: Construct truth tables and explain implication without assuming causation.
Translate necessary and sufficient conditions and distinguish converses from contrapositives.
State quantified predicates with explicit domains and negate nested quantifiers correctly.
Write preconditions, postconditions, and invariants for a small specification.
Use finite enumeration to find a witness or counterexample and state the limits of its conclusion.
zh: 构造真值表，并在不假定因果关系的情况下解释蕴含。
翻译必要与充分条件，区分逆命题与逆否命题。
为带量词的谓词明确论域，并正确否定嵌套量词。
为小型规格说明写出前置条件、后置条件与不变式。
用有限枚举寻找见证或反例，并说明结论的适用范围。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and build the four-row tables.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，构造四行真值表。

text.en: Predict and run Lab 1; explain the failing converse.
text.zh: 预测并运行实验 1，解释失败的逆命题。

text.en: Explain implication and its contrapositive from memory.
text.zh: 凭记忆解释蕴含与逆否命题。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and use the quantifier explorer.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节并使用量词探索器。

text.en: Run Lab 2; change the catalogue and test empty domains.
text.zh: 运行实验 2，改变目录并检验空论域。
证明练习 5 的等价式。

text.en: Read the proposition and implication selection.
text.zh: 阅读指定的命题与蕴含选段。

text.en: Read Section 5 and write a search contract.
text.zh: 阅读第 5 节并写出搜索约定。

text.en: Read predicate logic and explain one scope change.
text.zh: 阅读谓词逻辑，并解释一次作用域变化。

text.en: Retrieve the two quantified negation rules.
text.zh: 回忆两条量词否定规则。

text.en: Read Section 6 and diagnose the misconceptions.
text.zh: 阅读第 6 节并诊断常见误解。

text.en: Run Lab 3; repair the rule and explain both mismatches.
text.zh: 运行实验 3，修复规则并解释两处不一致。

text.en: Complete the choices, written response, and exit check.
text.zh: 完成选择题、书面回答与结业检查。
